settings.title: Settings
settings.headNote: Most settings take effect immediately on save; listen port and proxy URL require a service restart
settings.adminPasswordUpdated: Admin Password updated. Please log in again with the new password.
settings.adminPasswordHint: Takes effect immediately; the old password will stop working. You'll need to log in again after changing the Admin Password.
settings.selectStrategyDesc: Priority Mode picks accounts in priority order; Balanced Load rotates requests across available accounts.
settings.suggestionModeDesc: Controls whether the client's automatic next-input prediction request after each turn is forwarded. When enabled, the terminal shows AI suggestions in real time, but each sent message incurs an extra full-context billed request (default CC client behavior); when disabled (default), the server intercepts it and returns an empty response with zero token usage.
settings.thinkingAsTextDesc: Claude Code only. When enabled, extended-thinking content is streamed line by line as dimmed (gray) quoted text (like Kiro CLI), fixing Claude Code's default collapsed thinking that makes long reasoning look frozen; enabled by default; disable to keep native thinking blocks. In both modes Claude Code's own context contains the thinking content, but it is dropped entirely when history is sent upstream (off: native thinking blocks; on: marker line, thinking body and duration line), so the upstream context never contains thinking. Hot-switchable, applies to new requests only.
settings.clientTokenPassthroughDesc: Controls whether the usage fields are reported 1:1 with real token consumption. When enabled, actual values are passed through, for third-party clients that compute context usage from returned usage; when disabled (default), values are scaled by 0.6657 for display. Regardless of the switch state, Claude Code's auto-compact trigger timing remains unchanged.
settings.maxRpmPerCredentialDesc: Maximum requests per minute for each account; hot-applied on save (0 = unlimited).
settings.portDesc: HTTP port the service listens on (1–65535). Saved to config.json; takes effect after restart.
settings.proxyUrlDesc: Proxy for upstream requests (http/https/socks5); leave empty for direct connection. Saved to config.json; takes effect after restart.
settings.runtimeConfigSaveHint: port and proxyUrl changes take effect after restart
settings.languageDesc: Display language of this admin console; the preference is stored in your browser.
settings.themeDesc: Light or dark appearance; the preference is stored in your browser.
